_comment: Curated watch roles for the trends ledger (ADR-0051): specific roles worth their own trend line that are too small to earn a centroid (well under 1% of the clustered corpus each). Matched on TITLE patterns (case-insensitive regex), so membership is explainable per Job and survives a centroid refit. `parent` is the role_families.json family whose drill the role appears under; headstart.roles.load_watchlist validates it exists. Keep patterns precise — a loose pattern quietly inflates a series forever.
